thread:
emma (AE): Quick sync — Lightning Bank POC. They want BYO-KMS with an HSM-proxy in front of Redwood. 2-week trial window, can we support a rapid cutover test and a rotation dry-run? pricing delta and SLO impact asked. @sam can you chime in?

sam (SE): Yep. Need expected qps + per-request size. Also which HSM proxy protocol — KMIP or HTTP-based keyproxy?

alice (Lightning Bank): We're planning ~120 qps peak, average 30 qps. Token payloads small (~1KB). We'll use a vendor HSM proxy that speaks HTTP/gRPC; KMIP not available.

olivia (Security): For enterprise approval we need attestation docs (FIPS/PCI), key-escrow policy, and rotation proof plan. Also confirm customer-held CMK with no plaintext key export.

luis (Sales Eng): Pricing note: BYO-KMS + HSM proxy adds per-connection egress and integration effort. Two options: quick pilot (usage billing + one-time integration fee) vs reserved mini-dedicated for baseline latency (monthly commit). I can draft numbers if we lock trial window.

mike (SRE): Operational blockers: firewall pinholes for long-lived TLS connections, keepalives to avoid idle disconnects, and a preflight to exercise rotation without losing sessions. Recommend a staging cutover run at low traffic.

sam (SE): Integration checklist (short):
```
- TLS mTLS certs between proxy <-> Redwood endpoint
- Ports: 443 (proxy->api), 15001 (optional internal keepalive)
- Time sync NTP for rotation window alignment
- Retry/backoff on 429 and connection reset
```

emma (AE): @alice can you confirm which rotation cadence they want during trial? daily/weekly/monthly? Also any legal SOW constraints for test keys?

alice (Lightning Bank): We want to exercise a nightly rotation during the trial and a full key rollover once mid-trial. No escrow for test keys, production keys will be escrowed per contract.

olivia (Security): Nightly rotation OK for trial, but need a CR (change record) and rollback plan documented. We'll require HSM attestation and an audit log export after rotation test.

luis (Sales Eng): I'll prepare two quote lines tonight: one for pilot (integration + usage) and one for mini-dedicated (1-month commit). Expect ~48h turnaround.

mike (SRE): I'll schedule preflight with the customer for: connectivity smoke, rotation dry-run (non-prod), and latency baseline. Need contact for their ops person.

emma (AE): Action items: 1) @luis draft pricing (48h), 2) @sam produce runbook template and rotation steps (24h), 3) @mike schedule preflight with alice's ops, 4) @olivia gather attestation checklist. alice pls share ops point. :thumbsup:

alice (Lightning Bank): ops contact is raj.kumar@lightningbank.com. Raj will join preflight. Thanks everyone.

devops-bot: deploy-checklist created: /runbooks/poc/lightningbank/byo-kms-preflight (ops ticket #LB-POC-112)

emma (AE): Great, we'll sync tomorrow EOD to confirm SOW decisions. Thanks all.
